description:
Team Aegis represents Innovation University at NASA Space Apps Cairo. We are a passionate, multi-disciplinary team leveraging NASA Earth Observation data to build climate-resilient solutions for sustainable agriculture.

Our focus for the Field Shift challenge is developing Aegis-CropGuard-an Al-driven platform that translates complex satellite metrics (soil moisture, thermal stress, NDVI)

into actionable insights for farmers, protecting crop yields against severe climate shifts. Driven by!
